data.name: Rekha
data.long_meaning: A line or trace that can represent the journey of life, or the path to enlightenment. In Hinduism, Rekha is also the name of a goddess of love and beauty.

in_sanskrit.name: रेखा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who marks or indicates, the one who is the boundary or limit, the one who draws a line

in_hindi.name: रेखा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रेखा (Rekhā) is a name that has its origin in Sanskrit. It means 'line, edge, border'. The name suggests the one who marks or indicates, the one who is the boundary or limit, the one who draws a line.

in_tamil.name: ரேகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rēkā is the Tamil form of the Sanskrit name Rekhā. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rekha' which means 'line'. The name is often used to describe the one who marks or indicates, the one who is the boundary or limit, the one who draws a line.

in_telugu.name: రేఖా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rēkhā is the Telugu form of the Sanskrit name Rekhā. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rekha' which means 'line'. In Telugu, the name Rēkhā is translated as 'ళేధి' (Lēdhi), which also means 'line'.

in_marathi.name: Rekha

vedic_reference.note: Rekha is a Vedic name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rekha' which means 'line'. It is used in various Hindu scriptures and mythologies.

data.cultural_impact: The Hindu name "Rekha" has a profound cultural impact, representing the journey of life or the path to enlightenment. In Hindu mythology, a 'Rekha' is also referred to as a sacred line drawn to ward off negative energies or to mark the boundaries of sacred places. In day-to-day life, the name "Rekha" can be a reminder of the importance of drawing clear lines between right and wrong, and staying true to one's values and principles.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name "Rekha" holds deep spiritual significance as it is associated with the goddess of love and beauty, Rekha. This goddess is believed to bring harmony, balance, and grace into people's lives. The name "Rekha" can be a constant reminder of the divine presence of the goddess and the importance of cultivating love, beauty, and grace in one's own life. Moreover, the path to enlightenment, represented by the name "Rekha," is a spiritual journey that requires focus, determination, and self-reflection. The name can serve as a powerful reminder of this journey and the importance of staying dedicated to the pursuit of spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Rekha was a legendary heroine in ancient Indian epics, particularly in the Mahabharata. She was the wife of Prince Janamejaya and was known for her unwavering devotion and self-sacrifice. The story of Rekha's sacrifice is a powerful allegory of love and loyalty.

Rekha was also a famous actress and dancer in ancient India, particularly in the 15th and 16th centuries. She is believed to have been one of the greatest performers of her time and was known for her beauty and grace. Many of her performances were recorded in various literary works.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Rekha, a teacher in Kolkata, India, shares that their name Rekha meaning "Line, Trace, or Path" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Rekha symbolizes the indelible line of dharma (righteousness) that every individual must follow in life, guiding them towards spiritual growth and fulfillment. It also represents the divine connection between the mortal and the divine, as in the story of Lord Rama and Sita's marriage line (Rekha) drawn by Lord Agni.
